findings.R01: Answer uniqueness: every item has exactly one correct answer (duplicate correct histogram panels, a tie between strategies, a random-digit count that had more than one defensible answer)
findings.R02: Statistical statements and models: claims that summary statistics alone cannot support, causal and sampling wording, and the population a conclusion applies to
findings.R03: Simulation decisions: each decision rule states its model, the tail counted and the cutoff
findings.R04: Missing local givens and answer-form mismatches: each question restates what it uses, and the asked form matches the key
findings.R05: Probability models stated bank-wide: fairness, independence, random selection, replacement, guessing and payoffs (applied to every item found by the new check 28, not only the review's examples)
findings.R06: Precision and numeric wording: keys written to the stated precision; trailing-zero handling by the game checker documented (check 30)
findings.R07: Wording that overstated a claim (absolute statements, interval overlap read as proof)
findings.R08: Assessment quality: a MAIN item that only repeated its givens
findings.R09: Supplied simulation results labeled as hypothetical
